name: stage_a2_candidate_detection
description: Stage A2 - semantic candidate detection. Unit: one legal provision. Complements (does not replace) the regex-based Stage A1 in screening_v3.py.

AI_candidate.description: Does this provision potentially contain a regulatory relationship in which an analytically distinct actor mediates between a rule-maker/regulator and a rule-taker/target, even if none of the canonical intermediary labels appears?
